risk_note: DSX-48c H5 image component (feel plan ④, orchestrator D10-1032; ui-rules §3.6, 03 §10.6, fix program DSX-118 four states). components/base exports AsyncImage: frame data-slot=image-frame with data-state loading / loaded / error / empty, token placeholder keeping the aspect ratio, fade-in only through .h5-image-fade (opacity on var(--motion-duration-normal) var(--motion-easing-enter); none under reduced motion), loading=lazy and decoding=async, referrerPolicy only when the caller passes it, failure text from the dictionary (state.load_failed.title), empty src renders an empty frame without an img. Article images use it with no-referrer; the invite poster keeps alt='' and no referrer policy, shows the failure state inside its card instead of hiding it (screen readers hear it through the card's aria-describedby), and after a failure the card is aria-disabled so tapping no longer opens a broken preview (review r1 S2-2, fixed in round 2 with an optional Card disabled and AsyncImage onError). Bundle: every App route initial + route grows by at most +515 B (limit 3 KiB per route), all within the frozen 150 KiB (largest claim-form 145090 -> ~145605). Rule tests by an independent Claude; independent Claude spec-test review r1 pass (four S2 written into the implementation constraints and done); red on the local container (20 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in two rounds: local container browser run green for h5-image (round-2 browser run had one unrelated admin-pay-orders timeout under host load, green in round 1); container verify-fast OOM at tsc, host H5 frozen rule tests 773/773 and h5 unit tests 95/95 stand in, CI runs full verification. Non-funds. Codex usage limit: independent Claude general review r1 pass (S2-1 already covered by aria-describedby, S2-2 fixed), round-2 incremental review pass (one rare S2 logged as a follow-up). Written by hand.

reviews.note: Codex usage limit (until 2026-11-15), independent Claude per D10-823 ④: round 1 pass with two S2 (S2-1 covered by Card aria-describedby; S2-2 fixed in round 2), round 2 incremental pass (one rare S2 logged)

spec_test_review.note: independent Claude spec-test review round 1 pass, four S2 written into the implementation constraints; tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)
